item: Row 288 batch 2: 93 more test files open their SQLite engines with the app's pragmas
summary: 133 bare create_engine calls in 93 test files (none touched by an open PR) now go through tests/_app_engine.py::app_sqlite_engine, so they run with the app's foreign keys, WAL, busy timeout and cache settings; the converted files, every test file that imports one of them and the SQLCipher leg's damaged-store files pass (3000+ tests). Held back and reported to Plan, not reshaped: test_database_damage.py and test_damage_reread.py (the damaged-store family under R781), and test_country_migration.py and test_country_alternates.py, where on a WAL store the country-code migration's exclusive lock (src/backup/country_migration.py::take_exclusive) refuses with 'another program has this database open' in 10 tests. The ratchet ceiling goes from 742 to 609 calls in 448 files. Test-only, no release line.
